attributes.description:
Controls the width of the accordion component. This determines how wide the accordion panel appears on the screen.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-width

Controls the gap between accordion items. This determines the spacing between accordion headers and content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-gap

Controls the border thickness of the accordion component. This determines how thick the border around the accordion panel appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-border-width

Sets the border style of the accordion component. Acceptable values: solid, dashed, dotted.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-border-style

Sets the border color of the accordion component. This determines what color the border around the accordion panel appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-border-color

Controls the border radius for rounded corners of the accordion component. This makes the accordion appear with rounded corners instead of sharp edges.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-border-radius

Sets the background color of the accordion component. This is the main background color that appears behind all accordion content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-background-color

Sets the background color of the accordion title. This is the background color that appears
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-background-color

Sets the border width of the accordion title. This determines the thickness of the border that appears
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-width

Sets the border radius of the accordion title. This determines the roundness of the border that appears
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-radius

Sets the border color of the accordion title. This determines what color the border appears
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-color

Sets the text color of the accordion content. This determines what color the text within the accordion appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-text-color

Controls the size of the text in the accordion. This affects how large the accordion text appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-text-font-size

Controls the border thickness of the accordion header (bottom only). This determines how thick the border at the bottom of the header appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-border-width

Sets the border color of the accordion header. This determines what color the border around the header appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-border-color

Sets the background color of the accordion header. This is the background color that appears behind the header content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-background-color

Sets the internal spacing inside the accordion header. This creates breathing room around the header content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-padding

Controls the size of the subtitle text in the accordion header. This text is typically smaller than the main heading to create a visual hierarchy.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-subtitle-font-size

Controls the top margin of the accordion header subtitle. This creates spacing above the subtitle text.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-header-subtitle-margin-top

Sets the color of the accordion icon. This determines what color the icon appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-icon-color

Controls the size of the accordion icon. This affects how large the icon appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-icon-font-size

Controls the thickness/boldness of the accordion icon. Acceptable values: normal, bold, 100-900.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-icon-font-weight

Controls the size of the text in the accordion badge. This affects how large the badge text appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-font-size

Controls the right margin of the accordion badge. This creates spacing to the right of the badge.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-margin-right

Controls the width of the accordion badge. This determines how wide the badge appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-width

Controls the height of the accordion badge. This determines how tall the badge appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-height

Controls the border radius of the accordion badge. This makes the badge appear with rounded corners.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-border-radius

Controls the border thickness of the accordion badge. This determines how thick the border around the badge appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-border-width

Sets the border color of the accordion badge. This determines what color the border around the badge appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-border-color

Sets the background color of the accordion badge of default type. This is the background color that appears behind the badge content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-background-color

Sets the text color of the accordion badge. This determines what color the badge text appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-color

Sets the border color of the accordion pane. This determines what color the border around the pane appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-pane-border-color

Controls the border radius of the accordion pane. This determines the radius of the border around the pane.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-pane-border-radius

Controls the border thickness of the accordion pane. This determines how thick the border around the pane appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-pane-border-width

Controls the border style of the accordion pane. This determines the style of the border around the pane.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-pane-border-style

Controls the padding of the accordion title wrapper. This creates spacing around the title content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-padding

Controls the width of the accordion title wrapper. This determines the width of the title wrapper.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-width

Controls the border thickness of the accordion title wrapper. This determines how thick the border around the title wrapper appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-border-width

Controls the border radius of the accordion title wrapper. This determines the roundness of the border around the title wrapper.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-border-radius

Controls the border style of the accordion title wrapper. This determines the style of the border around the title wrapper.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-border-style

Sets the background color of the accordion title wrapper. This is the background color that appears behind the title content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-wrapper-background-color

Sets the icon color of the accordion title. This determines what color the icon within the accordion title appears in.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-icon-color

Controls the size of the icon in the accordion title. This affects how large the accordion title icon appears.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-title-icon-size

Sets the border color of the active accordion header. This determines what color the border appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-header-border-color

Sets the background color of the active accordion header. This is the background color that appears when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-header-background-color

Sets the background color of the active accordion content. This is the background color that appears when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-background-color

Sets the border width of the active accordion content. This determines the thickness of the border that appears when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-width

Sets the border radius of the active accordion content. This determines the roundness of the border that appears when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-radius

Sets the border color of the active accordion content. This determines what color the border appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-border-color

Sets the text color of the active accordion content. This determines what color the text appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-text-color

Sets the icon color of the active accordion title. This determines what color the icon appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-title-icon-color

Sets the color of the active accordion icon. This determines what color the icon appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-icon-color

Sets the border color of the active accordion badge. This determines what color the border appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-badge-border-color

Sets the background color of the active accordion badge of default type. This is the background color that appears behind the badge content.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-badge-background-color

Sets the text color of the active accordion badge. This determines what color the badge text appears in when the accordion is expanded.
CSS variable: --wm-accordion-active-badge-color
